## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] Domain tests do not perform I/O
- [ ] Public API changes have XML doc comments
- [ ] No new top-level project introduced without prior discussion
- [ ] No new NuGet package without entry in `Directory.Packages.props`
- [ ] If migrations changed: schema reviewed, no edits to shipped migrations
- [ ] If methodology changed: ADR drafted under `docs/adr/`
